title: Autumn Leaves Beanie
description: A cosy, slouchy beanie knitted in the round featuring a delicate repeating leaf lace motif. Worked from the brim upward in DK weight yarn, this is a satisfying first lace project that knits up quickly. One size fits most adults with a stretchy ribbed brim.
yarnRequirements: 100–120g DK weight yarn (approx. 220–265m). Shown in burnt orange.
gauge: 22 sts × 28 rows = 10 cm in stocking stitch on 4 mm needles
materials: 4 mm circular needles (40 cm) or DPNs

instructions.title: Ribbed Brim
instructions.body: Cast on 112 sts using the long-tail method onto 3.5 mm needles. Join to work in the round, being careful not to twist. Place marker. Work k2, p2 rib for 5 cm.

instructions.title: Body
instructions.body: Switch to 4 mm needles. Work the Autumn Leaf repeat (12-st repeat × 9, plus 4 extra sts for centring) for 12 cm as follows — Round 1: *k2, yo, k1, ssk, k1, k2tog, k1, yo, k2; repeat. Round 2: knit. Repeat these 2 rounds throughout the body.

instructions.title: Crown Shaping
instructions.body: Begin decreases when hat measures 18 cm total. Round 1: *k8, k2tog; repeat to end. Rounds 2–4: knit. Round 5: *k7, k2tog; repeat. Continue decreasing 1 st in each repeat every 4th round until 14 sts remain.

instructions.title: Finishing
instructions.body: Cut yarn leaving a 20 cm tail. Thread through remaining sts with tapestry needle, pull tight, and secure on the inside. Weave in all ends. Block by soaking in lukewarm water, pressing in a towel, and drying over a balloon or hat form.

reviews.author: sarah_k92
reviews.body: Absolutely love this pattern! Made it in one weekend. Came out perfectly and the leaf motif is just gorgeous 🍂

reviews.author: tomB
reviews.body: Really nice pattern, though I had to re-read the decrease section a few times before i got it. Came out lovely in the end though - definitely recommend!

reviews.author: KnittingMum_Clare
reviews.body: Third time making this and gifted two already. Everyone always asks where I got it from. My go-to quick gift pattern.

reviews.author: dan1983
reviews.body: It's ok. The leaf motif is a bit fiddly and a couple of the instructions could be clearer. Nice end result but took me longer than expected for something labelled beginner.

reviews.author: jenny_wool
reviews.body: SO cute!! Mine turned out a bit wonky the first time but second attempt was perfcet lol. Free pattern too which is amazing.

reviews.author: R_Hutchings
reviews.body: Good solid beginner pattern. Took me about 6 evenings as a fairly new knitter. Very satisfying to wear when done.
